title: Observability telemetry policy lifecycle, schema-driven scrubbing, and access provenance
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Implement a policy-driven lifecycle for telemetry (traces, metrics, logs) that enables schema-driven scrubbing, tenant-scoped retention profiles, and deterministic access provenance without regressing latency or observability coverage. This ticket covers the end-to-end design and an initial implementation for trace and log ingestion pipelines, a masking/translation engine, and an access-audit stream integrated with RBAC and KMS-wrapped storage. The work should allow product teams to declare policies (retain X for Y days, mask fields tagged PII, allow read-only auditing for support roles) and have those policies enforced consistently across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Schema registry support for telemetry types with field-level sensitivity tags (PII/PHI/internal) available in staging
A pipeline transform that applies schema-driven scrubbing to traces and logs with configurable masks (redact, truncate, hash) and preserves non-sensitive metric labels
Per-tenant retention profiles enforced downstream (hot cache duration, cold storage TTL) and surfaced in Console UI
Access provenance events (who queried/streamed telemetry) emitted to an encrypted audit stream with tenant and request metadata
RBAC integration: console and API access to telemetry honor role policies and generate just-in-time elevation requests recorded in audit stream
End-to-end latency impact <= 5% on 95th percentile for trace ingestion vs baseline when scrubbing is enabled
Automated e2e test harness validating redaction rules against synthetic PII examples
Security review completed and documented with remediation actions tracked
Runbook for incidents where improper retention/policy application occurs
tasks: Design: policy schema and CLI/Console UX for telemetry lifecycle rules
Engine: implement pipeline transform plugin for schema-driven scrubbing
Storage: add per-tenant TTL enforcement hooks in cold storage worker
Auth: emit access provenance events from the query gateway with tenant-scoped headers
Integration: wire RBAC decisions into telemetry read API and Console views
Infra: KMS wrapping for audit stream and retention metadata
Perf: microbenchmarks for transform CPU cost and p95 increase
QA: create synthetic corpora and fuzz tests for scrubbing rules
Docs: developer guide, operations runbook, and Console help text
Rollout: staged canary for 10%->50%->100% tenants with rollback hooks
comments: 2025-02-11 — Aisha Patel: Kicked off RFC thread. Proposal linked below. Key decision: prefer declarative policy files that can be applied per-tenant rather than hardcoded pipeline stages. Asked infra to estimate storage cost impact for per-tenant TTLs.

2025-02-17 — Marco Nguyen: Spike done — prototype transform plugin using a lightweight WASM sandbox. Baseline CPU overhead looks acceptable for low-cardinality traces. Link to spike PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/842

2025-02-21 — Priya Rao (Security): Reviewed prototype. Recommended adding deterministic hashing option for hashed-sensitive-fields to enable downstream dedup without exposing raw PII. Security review flagged need for KMS-wrapped keys for audit stream — marking security_review_required=true.

2025-02-26 — Marco Nguyen: Implemented schema registry integration. Registry stores per-field sensitivity and recommended mask. Added migration for existing schemas. Migration PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/schema-registry/pull/123

2025-03-01 — SRE (Jared Kim): Ran perf harness. Observed 4.3% p95 ingestion latency increase with scrubbing enabled under 1000rps trace load. Memory footprint increased by ~120MB on ingest workers. Documenting autoscaling recommendation in infra notes.
2025-03-04 — PM feedback (Lina Torres): Console UX copy refined; requested retention presets (standard/nearline/strict) and ability to preview masked output before applying policy. Added to tasks.
2025-03-05 — Marco Nguyen: Started canary rollout plan for staging orgs. Creating feature flag gate (telemetry.policy.v1) and staged monitor dashboards for policy application success/failure rates.
2025-03-05 — Security (Priya Rao): Confirmed KMS integration design — audit stream uses envelope encryption, rotation plan required. Created follow-up ticket ENG-40402 for key rotation automation.
